digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
problem_keywords: Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria rename
propositions: Dual vocabulary of 'Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts creates semantic noise by suggesting a distinction the rubrics do not implement

The phrase 'acceptance/success criterion' appears across multiple reviewer prompt files and must be collapsed to 'acceptance criterion' with 'Success Criteria' standalone sections renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria'
Bare tokens 'SC' in plan_review_G3.md ('THREE SC-CONTRADICTION PATTERNS' and 'SC says zero matches') must be manually replaced with 'AC' equivalents to avoid false matches on 'O-RAN-SC'
The criteria_routing.json routing index contains check strings that reference Success Criteria and must be updated, rotating the regver stamp to invalidate stale plan-review attestations

The generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must be regenerated from updated prompts via registry command to remove all in-scope Success Criteria vocabulary while preserving the T2 pilot-metrics exception and definition-of-done wording
